svg.title: particle-physics-simulation
svg.desc: An ASCII Verlet simulation. A nozzle at the upper left of a round container fires a stream of particles that arc across, bounce off the wall, slide down and pile up at the bottom. The newest particle is drawn in orange. Then the bottom opens, the pile pours out and the empty container is ready for the next run.
